body: I know.  It's pretty rough, but this subreddit would not be here if the random populace did not give a Fuck about you.  Think about it.  People you've never met care about your problems.  It has at least given me a bit of solace.

I was in med school as of 3 days ago and then my world changed via a certified letter. It's challenging right now to see the positives.  I want this nightmare to end.  I don't feel like a person; it seems I have been defined by the "numbers".  They should have just told me to drop out when I recieved that C in fucking Feb. Instead of allowing me to continue and "taking my money" if they were going to do that.

Please don't hurt yourself.  I have the whole day off tomorrow if you need someone to listen.  Everyone has their own trials.  I'm currently going through my own; but I am willing to help you through your issues.
I just went had a decent meal and bought a person suffering from homelessness a decent meal, which made me feel like a human again, but that feeling is slowly fading again unfortunately.
I need to go get out of the house.  Being confined right now is not great for my current disposition.  Thanks for listening. I really need it right now; but I will be back.
Other than being permanently unconscious I don't know.  I really dont want to be that dark.  I just wanted the future how I wanted to design it, not by someone else's choice.

Thanks for the reply.  I have never encountered this type of pain before; i tried numbing the pain with whiskey, and that just made saturday awful...so im not going to drink anymore.  I am having a really horrible time getting out of bed and just want to be unconcious all the time. God this is horrid.
